name: tuned 2560x1440 @ 90fps
description: Measured on this machine (RTX 4070 SUPER / 2560x1440 180 Hz panel) against a 1440p AV1 24p source: 131 fps median, 130 fps worst of three runs, against a 90 fps target -- 1.44x. 90 fps is exactly half of 180 Hz, so every frame occupies precisely two refreshes and no frame is resampled. Backend is mvtools (CPU) on purpose: RIFE measured 23 fps at this resolution on this GPU, five times slower than the CPU path. The GPU still decodes the AV1 and drives the output.
